svg.title: W.E.D.N.E.S.D.A.Y.
svg.desc: W.E.D.N.E.S.D.A.Y.: Watchful Earth-Data Navigator, Entirely Self-hosted Desktop Assistant for You. A personal AI assistant that runs on your own computer, with a living Earth at its centre. A turning globe with earthquake pulses, a satellite orbit and an aircraft track; the core's W line cycles through its states. Illustrative artwork; nothing in it is live data.
svg.text: A personal AI assistant that runs on your own
computer, with a living Earth at its centre.
one line, one behaviour per state
USGS · NASA EONET · GDACS · CELESTRAK · OPEN-METEO
